TERMINAL_CODE = "CT03"
WRITE_MODE    = "overwrite"
FULL_REFRESH = False

# ── Storage ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
STORAGE_ACCOUNT = "navispowerbidatastorage2"
CONTAINER       = "adani-ct03"          # <-- adjust to this terminal's container

BRONZE_PATH = (
    f"abfss://{CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    f"bronze/movehistory/load"
)
ARCHIVE_ROOT = (
    f"abfss://{CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    f"bronze/moves/archive"
)
SILVER_PATH = (
    f"abfss://{CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    f"silver/moves/"
)
MERGE_KEY = "mve_gkey"
SENTINEL_DISTANCE = 100_000_000

# ── Accepted timestamp formats (first successful parse wins) ───────────────────
# Only list formats that cannot be confused with each other.
# dd/MM/yyyy and MM/dd/yyyy CLASH for days 1-12 -> enable ONE of them, never both.
TS_FORMATS = [
    "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS",     # current source: 2026-10-19 23:39:05.850
    "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss",         # current source, no milliseconds
    # "dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss",       # enable ONE of these if the source changes
    # "MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss",
]

print(f"Terminal  : {TERMINAL_CODE}")
print(f"Bronze    : {BRONZE_PATH}")
print(f"Silver    : {SILVER_PATH}")
print(f"Write mode: {WRITE_MODE}")
print(f"TS formats: {TS_FORMATS}")

import re
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import (
    StructType, StructField,
    StringType, ShortType, IntegerType,

# ── Terminal position parsers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# CT03 yard slot:  Y-CT03-<block(digit+letter)><bay(2d)><row(letter)><tier(digit)>
# Example:         Y-CT03-1K19G3  ->  block=1K  bay=19  row=G  tier=3
# Special areas:   Y-CT03-EXAM    ->  block=EXAM  row="Buffer"
#
# parse_fail = 1 only when the code after the yard prefix is neither a standard slot
# nor a plain area code (letters first), e.g. a truncated slot like "Y-CT03-1K19G".

def _make_parser(code, tier_type="numeric"):
    prefix = f"Y-{code}-"
    return {
        "yard_prefix"    : prefix,
        "yard_pattern"   : re.compile(
            rf"^{re.escape(prefix)}(\d?[A-Z]{{1,2}})(\d{{2,3}})([A-Z])(\d{{1,2}})$"
        ),
        "special_pattern": re.compile(r"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$"),
        "groups"         : {"block": 1, "bay": 2, "row": 3, "tier": 4},
        "tier_type"      : tier_type,
    }

TERMINAL_PARSERS = {
    "CT03": _make_parser("CT03"),
    # "XYZ": _make_parser("XYZ"),                        # numeric tier
    # "MFT": {... alpha-tier pattern, see old notebook},  # alpha tier
}
DEFAULT_PARSER = "CT03"

# First letter of a position name -> location type (V / T inferred from sample data)
POSITION_PREFIX_TYPE = {"Y": "YARD", "V": "VESSEL", "T": "TRUCK"}

# ── Column spec: (bronze header, silver name, kind) ────────────────────────────
#   str  trimmed string, '' -> NULL
#   id   string ID, trailing ".0" removed ('28.0' -> '28'), keeps leading zeros
#   long BIGINT (via decimal(20,0), so '12672.0' and 12672.0 both work)
#   int  INT
#   dec  DECIMAL(18,3)
#   ts   TIMESTAMP parsed with TS_FORMATS
#   flag Yes/No/1/0 -> BYTE (1/0)
#   bool Yes/No/1/0 -> BOOLEAN
COLUMN_SPEC = [
    # keys
    ("Event Gkey",                     "mve_gkey",               "long"),
    ("Unit Visit Gkey",                "unit_visit_gkey",        "long"),
    ("Container Nbr",                  "unit_nbr",               "str"),
    ("Move Kind",                      "move_kind",              "str"),
    # positions
    ("From Position",                  "from_position_name",     "str"),
    ("To Position",                    "to_position_name",       "str"),
    # timestamps
    ("Put Time",                       "t_put",                  "ts"),
    ("Dispatch Time",                  "t_dispatch",             "ts"),
    ("Fetch Time",                     "t_fetch",                "ts"),
    ("Carry Complete Time",            "t_carry_complete",       "ts"),
    ("Discharge Time",                 "t_discharge",            "ts"),
    ("Carry Dispatch Time",            "t_carry_dispatch",       "ts"),
    ("Carry Fetch Ready Time",         "t_carry_fetch_ready",    "ts"),
    ("Carry Put Ready Time",           "t_carry_put_ready",      "ts"),
    # distances / counts
    ("Unladen Distance",               "dist_unladen",           "dec"),
    ("Laden Distance",                 "dist_laden",             "dec"),
    ("Rehandles",                      "rehandles",              "int"),
    # unit attributes
    ("Category",                       "category_id",            "str"),
    ("Freight Kind",                   "freight_kind_id",        "str"),
    ("Gross Weight Kg",                "gross_wt_kg",            "dec"),
    ("VGM Kg",                         "vgm_wt_kg",              "dec"),
    ("Equipment Type",                 "equipment_type",         "str"),
    ("Equipment Class ISO",            "equipment_class_iso",    "str"),
    ("POD",                            "pod",                    "str"),
    ("POL",                            "pol",                    "str"),
    ("Deck Logic",                     "deck_logic",             "str"),
    ("Weight Logic",                   "weight_logic",           "str"),
    ("USRE",                           "usre",                   "str"),
    ("USRF",                           "usrf",                   "str"),
    # carriers
    ("Arrival Position Location Type", "arrival_pos_loc_type",   "str"),
    ("Inbound Carrier Mode",           "inbound_carrier_mode",   "str"),
    ("Arrival Mode - Preliminary",     "arrival_mode_prelim",    "str"),
    ("Inbound Carrier Visit",          "inbound_carrier_visit",  "id"),
    ("Inbound Service",                "inbound_service",        "str"),
    ("Outbound Carrier Visit",         "outbound_carrier_visit", "id"),
    ("Outbound Service",               "outbound_service",       "str"),
    ("Move Carrier Visit Gkey",        "carrier_visit_key",      "long"),
    # stow / hazmat / flags
    ("Section Factor",                 "section_factor",         "str"),
    ("Stacking Factor",                "stacking_factor",        "str"),
    ("Special Stow 1",                 "special_stow_1",         "str"),
    ("Special Stow 2",                 "special_stow_2",         "str"),
    ("Special Stow 3",                 "special_stow_3",         "str"),
    ("IMDG Code",                      "imdg_code",              "str"),
    ("Hazard UN Numbers",              "hazard_un_numbers",      "id"),
    ("Hazardous",                      "hazardous_flag",         "bool"),
    ("Requires Power",                 "requires_power_flag",    "bool"),
    ("OOG",                            "oog_flag",               "bool"),
    ("Twin Fetch Raw",                 "twin_fetch",             "flag"),
    ("Twin Carry Raw",                 "twin_carry",             "flag"),
    ("Twin Put Raw",                   "twin_put",               "flag"),
    ("Restow Reason",                  "restow_reason",          "str"),
    ("POW",                            "pow",                    "str"),
    ("Berth",                          "berth_id",               "str"),
    ("Line Operator",                  "container_line_id",      "str"),
    # equipment
    ("Fetch CHE Gkey",                 "fetch_che_gkey",         "long"),
    ("Carry CHE Gkey",                 "carry_che_gkey",         "long"),
    ("Put CHE Gkey",                   "put_che_gkey",           "long"),
    ("Fetch CHE ID",                   "fetch_che_id",           "id"),
    ("Fetch CHE Kind",                 "fetch_che_kind",         "str"),
    ("Fetch CHE Operator Id",          "fetch_che_operator_id",  "id"),
    ("Carry CHE ID",                   "carry_che_id",           "id"),
    ("Carry CHE Kind",                 "carry_che_kind",         "str"),
    ("Carry CHE Operator Id",          "carry_che_operator_id",  "id"),
    ("Put CHE ID",                     "put_che_id",             "id"),
    ("Put CHE Kind",                   "put_che_kind",           "str"),
    ("Put CHE Operator Id",            "put_che_operator_id",    "id"),
]

_TRUE  = ["YES", "Y", "TRUE", "1", "1.0"]
_FALSE = ["NO",  "N", "FALSE", "0", "0.0"]


def _as_str(c):
    return F.trim(F.col(f"`{c}`").cast("string"))


def build_col(src, kind):
    s = _as_str(src)
    if kind == "str":
        return F.when(s == "", None).otherwise(s)
    if kind == "id":
        t = F.regexp_replace(s, r"\.0+$", "")
        return F.when(t == "", None).otherwise(t)
    if kind == "long":
        return s.cast("decimal(20,0)").cast("bigint")
    if kind == "int":
        return s.cast("decimal(20,0)").cast("int")
    if kind == "dec":
        return s.cast("decimal(18,3)")
    if kind == "ts":
        return F.coalesce(*[F.to_timestamp(s, f) for f in TS_FORMATS])
    if kind in ("flag", "bool"):
        u = F.upper(s)
        f = (F.when(u.isin(_TRUE), F.lit(1))
              .when(u.isin(_FALSE), F.lit(0))
              .otherwise(None))
        return f.cast("byte") if kind == "flag" else f.cast("boolean")
    raise ValueError(kind)

# ── Select, rename & cast ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
available = set(bronze.columns)
spec      = [(s, t, k) for s, t, k in COLUMN_SPEC if s in available]

silver = bronze.select(*[build_col(s, k).alias(t) for s, t, k in spec])

# ── Fail loudly if any non-empty timestamp could not be parsed ────────────────
_ts_cols = [(s, t) for s, t, k in spec if k == "ts"]
if _ts_cols:
    _src = bronze.agg(*[F.sum(F.when(F.trim(F.col(f"`{s}`").cast("string")) != "", 1).otherwise(0)).alias(t)
                        for s, t in _ts_cols]).collect()[0]
    _dst = silver.agg(*[F.count(F.col(t)).alias(t) for _, t in _ts_cols]).collect()[0]
    _bad = {t: (_src[t] or 0) - (_dst[t] or 0) for _, t in _ts_cols if (_src[t] or 0) != (_dst[t] or 0)}
    assert not _bad, f"Timestamp parse failures (column: rows). Add the new format to TS_FORMATS: {_bad}"
    print(f"Timestamp check OK for {len(_ts_cols)} columns")

# ── Nullify sentinel distance values ──────────────────────────────────────────
for dist_col in ["dist_unladen", "dist_laden"]:
    if dist_col in silver.columns:
        silver = silver.withColumn(
            dist_col,
            F.when(F.col(dist_col) >= F.lit(SENTINEL_DISTANCE), None)
             .otherwise(F.col(dist_col))
        )

# ── move_date from t_put, facility ────────────────────────────────────────────
silver = (
    silver
    .withColumn("facility_id", F.lit(TERMINAL_CODE))
    .withColumn("move_date",   F.to_date(F.col("t_put")))
)

# ── Location type from position prefix (Y-/V-/T-) ─────────────────────────────
_type_map = F.create_map(*[x for kv in POSITION_PREFIX_TYPE.items() for x in map(F.lit, kv)])
for side in ("from", "to"):
    pos = F.col(f"{side}_position_name")
    silver = silver.withColumn(
        f"{side}_loc_type",
        F.when(pos.isNull(), None)
         .otherwise(F.coalesce(_type_map[F.substring(pos, 1, 1)], F.lit("OTHER")))
    )

# ── Parse yard positions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
silver = (
    silver
    .withColumn("_fm", parse_position_udf(F.col("from_position_name")))
    .withColumn("_to", parse_position_udf(F.col("to_position_name")))
    .withColumn("fm_yard_block",      F.col("_fm.block"))
    .withColumn("fm_yard_bay",        F.col("_fm.bay"))
    .withColumn("fm_yard_row",        F.col("_fm.row"))
    .withColumn("fm_yard_tier",       F.col("_fm.tier").cast("smallint"))
    .withColumn("fm_yard_parse_fail", F.col("_fm.parse_fail").cast("boolean"))
    .withColumn("to_yard_block",      F.col("_to.block"))
    .withColumn("to_yard_bay",        F.col("_to.bay"))
    .withColumn("to_yard_row",        F.col("_to.row"))
    .withColumn("to_yard_tier",       F.col("_to.tier").cast("smallint"))
    .withColumn("to_yard_parse_fail", F.col("_to.parse_fail").cast("boolean"))
    .drop("_fm", "_to")
)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

silver = silver.filter(F.col(MERGE_KEY).isNotNull())     # keys can't be merged without a value
silver = silver.withColumn("row_hash", F.xxhash64(*[F.col(c) for c in silver.columns]))

w = Window.partitionBy(MERGE_KEY).orderBy(F.col("t_put").desc_nulls_last(), F.col("row_hash").desc())
before = silver.count()
silver = (silver.withColumn("_rn", F.row_number().over(w))
                .filter("_rn = 1").drop("_rn")
                .withColumn("_silver_loaded_at", F.current_timestamp())
                .persist())
print(f"Duplicate {MERGE_KEY} rows removed: {before - silver.count():,}")

total     = silver.count()
fm_fail   = silver.filter(F.col("fm_yard_parse_fail") == True).count()
to_fail   = silver.filter(F.col("to_yard_parse_fail") == True).count()
null_date = silver.filter(F.col("move_date").isNull()).count()
null_key  = silver.filter(F.col("mve_gkey").isNull()).count()

print("=" * 55)
print(f"  Total rows               : {total:,}")
print(f"  Null mve_gkey            : {null_key:,}")
print(f"  FROM yard parse-fail     : {fm_fail:,}")
print(f"  TO   yard parse-fail     : {to_fail:,}")
print(f"  Null move_date (no t_put): {null_date:,}")
print("=" * 55)

if fm_fail + to_fail > 0:
    print("\n⚠️  Unrecognized yard positions — review before adding new terminal:")
    display(
        silver.filter(F.col("fm_yard_parse_fail") | F.col("to_yard_parse_fail"))
        .groupBy("facility_id", "from_position_name", "to_position_name")
        .count()
        .orderBy(F.desc("count"))
    )

print("\nMove type distribution (move_kind, from_loc_type -> to_loc_type):")
display(
    silver.groupBy("move_kind", "from_loc_type", "to_loc_type")
          .count()
          .orderBy(F.desc("count"))
)

from delta.tables import DeltaTable

if FULL_REFRESH or not DeltaTable.isDeltaTable(spark, SILVER_PATH):
    (silver.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite")
        .option("overwriteSchema", "true")
        # .partitionBy("move_date")   # enable at high volume
        .save(SILVER_PATH))
    print(f"✅  Initial load: {total:,} rows → {SILVER_PATH}")
else:
    target = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, SILVER_PATH)
    (target.alias("t")
        .merge(silver.alias("s"), f"t.{MERGE_KEY} = s.{MERGE_KEY}")
        .whenMatchedUpdateAll(condition="t.row_hash <> s.row_hash")
        .whenNotMatchedInsertAll()
        .execute())
    m = target.history(1).select("operationMetrics").collect()[0][0]
    print(f"✅  MERGE complete | inserted: {m.get('numTargetRowsInserted')} | updated: {m.get('numTargetRowsUpdated')}")

# ── Archive processed files (only reached if the write above succeeded) ───────
archived = 0
for f in load_files:
    rel  = f.path.split(LOAD_PATH.rstrip("/") + "/", 1)[-1]
    dest = f"{ARCHIVE_ROOT}/{RUN_ID}/{rel}"
    mssparkutils.fs.mv(f.path, dest, True)
    archived += 1
print(f"✅  Archived {archived} file(s) → {ARCHIVE_ROOT}/{RUN_ID}/")

silver.unpersist()
